name: Nerve Bridge
fix_description: In _calculateSwap (SwapUtils library), multiply the LP token balance by virtualPrice before computing the swap output, consistent with how _calculateSwapUnderlying handles it. This eliminates the pricing discrepancy between swap and swapUnderlying.
difficulty_reasoning: This exploit is a multi-step DeFi attack involving a flash loan, Curve/Saddle-style metapool swaps, LP mint/burn mechanics, and a repeated loop to drain value via protocol-specific accounting. While the PoC is short, understanding why the fusd/metaSwap/3pool interactions are exploitable requires reading the pool logic and stable-swap internals, so it is more than a straightforward bug.
